newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-IBCA gives B rating to Malaysia's Public Bank.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-IBCA gives B rating to Malaysia's Public Bank.

text.p: Credit rating agency IBCA said on Friday it had assigned an individual rating of B to Malaysia's Public Bank Berhad and affirmed its legal rating of 2 for the bank.

"In the agency's view, Public Bank is one with superior asset quality indicators and a solid history of profitability, underpinned by significant contributions from its non-bank finance subsidiaries," IBCA said.
Public Bank had undergone a rapid expansion of its loan book in recent years, with growth of 40 percent well above the overall Malaysian system's loan growth rate of 30 percent, IBCA said.

"However, IBCA believes this growth reflets the extensive branch network's previous level of underutilised market capacity, rather than overly aggressive lending: there is little evidence of a decline in credit standards, and new loans per branch still remain lower than that for Public Bank's two major peers." The current mild slowdown in the Malaysian economy may increase non-performing loans across the sector, IBCA said.
"However, it is unlikely that Public Bank will be unduly affected by such an increase," it said.
